Years later, she is reincarnated as the bride to be of her enemy’s brother, the fifth prince, a silly prince whom the royal family regards as worthless. In him she sees her past pitiful self and promises to protect this foolish yet kind prince. But is this foolish prince really all that he seems? Des années plus tard, elle s'est réincarnée dans le corps d'une future mariée. Elle s'apprête à épouser le frère de son ennemi, un prince idiot que toute la famille royale déteste.  
Elle est parfaitement d'accord, car ce garçon stupide est le seul à lui avoir montré un peu de chaleur au cours de ses deux vies.

Mientras pedía limosna a la tierna edad de diez años, Momo fue secuestrado por unos traficantes de niños y encerrado en un barco de cargamento.

title.en: A Star Reborn: The Queen's Return

description.en:
She was the Queen of Song, but she died during her greatest years.  
After she was reincarnated, she became a simple trainee. She lost her former glory? It doesn't matter—no one can compete with her beautiful singer's voice. She's mocked for her lowly birth? It doesn't matter—her true identity is enough to make the whole world tremble. She owes huge debts? It doesn't matter…  
A powerful boss whispered to her: "The debt will disappear if you would become my woman."  
But she is proud: "I'm sorry. I would sell my art, but not my whole self."  
————————————————  
This is the story of the Queen of Song, of her return to the peak… and an overbearing chairman.

description.en: I don't know when men lost their comprehension physiques, unable to gather their souls for cultivation, and cultivation became exclusive to women. What's more terrible... There seems to be a huge problem with the aesthetics of men in this world! The handsome male protagonist Luo Yang is considered an ugly man, and became a ferryman in the magpie building, but secretly he is a super paparazzi who has a lot of information, and as the only male in the cultivation world who can cultivate, his cultivation has reached the emperor level . Because of falling in love at first sight with Xia Peng who came to the Que Que Tower , she voluntarily became her exclusive stove. Since then, the sect that was originally mixed with fish and dragons has been turned upside down because of the arrival of the male lead...Hmph...What I want to cultivate is the future Empress!
description.pt-br: Não sei quando os homens perderam a compreensão física, incapazes de reunir suas almas para o cultivo, e o cultivo se tornou exclusivo das mulheres. O que é mais terrível… Parece haver um grande problema com a estética dos homens neste mundo! O belo protagonista masculino Luo Yang é considerado um homem feio e se tornou um barqueiro no prédio da putaria, mas secretamente ele é um super paparazzi que tem muitas informações e como o único homem no mundo do cultivo que pode cultivar, seu cultivo atingiu o nível de imperador. Por se apaixonar à primeira vista por Xia Peng, que veio para a Torre Que, ela se tornou voluntariamente seu fogão exclusivo. Desde então, a seita que foi originalmente misturada com peixes e dragões virou de cabeça para baixo por causa da chegada do protagonista masculino… Hmph… O que eu quero cultivar é a futura Imperatriz.

description.en: Lu Xi Li, with only 3 months to live due to cancer, unexpectedly meets with his first love in the hospital, Chen Jun Ge. He thought it was fate, but a second later discovers that he already has a boyfriend. 3 months after his sad death Lu Xi Li realizes that he is in the body of his first love's boyfriend. At that moment he discovers that they are not a couple, in fact they are enemies…the journey to conquest* that man is very long!
description.es: Lu Xi Li, con sólo 3 meses de vida debido al cáncer, se encuentra inesperadamente con su primer amor en el hospital, Chen Jun Ge. Pensó que era el destino, pero un segundo después descubre que ya tiene novio. Tres meses después de su triste fallecimiento, Lu Xi Li se da cuenta de que está en el cuerpo del novio de su primer amor. En ese momento descubre que no son una pareja, de hecho son enemigos… ¡el viaje para conquistar a ese hombre es muy largo!

description.en: Legend has it that over 400 ancient demons are sealed within the magical demon-collecting vessel known as the "Voodoo Tower." However, in a terrible accident, the seal was broken and released the demons into the human world! Now, the keeper of the Voodoo Tower- the demon-collecting lynx war god- has to embark on a journey to recapture his demons!
description.zh-hk: 傳說，源自上古時代便存在於世上的四百妖魔，都封印在名為「伏魔塔」的收妖寶器之中;然而，在一次意外中，封印解開，妖魔紛亂竄出，並降世於人世間！！如今，伏魔塔的保管者——收妖戰神猞猁，將展開壯烈精彩的收妖冒險！！
